#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int N; cin >> N;
    int M = 3;
    vector<int> A(M), B(M);
    for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) cin >> A[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) cin >> B[i];

    int initial_sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
        initial_sum += min(A[i], B[(i + 1) % M]);
    }

    int size = 2 * M + 2;
    int s = 2 * M;
    int t = 2 * M + 1;

    // Graph represented as adjacency list: each edge is (to, capacity, rev)
    std::vector<std::vector<std::tuple<int, int, int>>> graph(size);

    auto add_edge = [&](int u, int v, int cap) {
        graph[u].emplace_back(v, cap, (int)graph[v].size());
        graph[v].emplace_back(u, 0, (int)graph[u].size() - 1);
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
        add_edge(s, i, N);
        add_edge(M + i, t, B[i]);
        add_edge(i, M + i, A[i]);
        add_edge(i, M + ((i - 1 + M) % M), A[i]);
    }

    int flow = 0;
    while (true) {
        std::vector<int> level(size, -1);
        level[s] = 0;
        std::queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (auto &[to, cap, rev] : graph[v]) {
                if (cap > 0 && level[to] < 0) {
                    level[to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.push(to);
                }
            }
        }
        if (level[t] < 0) break;

        std::vector<int> iter(size, 0);
        std::function<int(int, int)> dfs = [&](int v, int upTo) {
            if (v == t) return upTo;
            for (int &i = iter[v]; i < (int)graph[v].size(); i++) {
                auto &[to, cap, rev] = graph[v][i];
                if (cap > 0 && level[v] < level[to]) {
                    int pushed = dfs(to, std::min(upTo, cap));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        cap -= pushed;
                        auto &[r_cap, r_rev, r_rev_idx] = graph[to][rev];
                        std::get<1>(graph[to][rev]) += pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        };

        int pushed;
        while ((pushed = dfs(s, 1000000000)) > 0) {
            flow += pushed;
        }
    }

    int res = N - flow;
    std::cout << res << " " << initial_sum << "\n";

    return 0;
}
